zh: 人的眼球大致呈球形（图 184），直径约为 $2.5$ 厘米。
眼球外层白色的保护组织叫作巩膜 $1$，前部透明的组织叫作角膜 $2$。
原书把角膜描述为巩膜前面的透明部分，这里需澄清：角膜与巩膜相接，但不是变透明的巩膜。
角膜后方有虹膜 $3$，它的颜色来自组织中的色素，并不是后来被染色。
角膜与虹膜之间的前房充满房水 $4$，虹膜中央的开口是瞳孔 $5$。
瞳孔会随入射光强度发生反射性的大小变化，原书给出的直径约 $2$ 到 $8$ 毫米只作大致范围，实际大小还随条件和个体而变。
瞳孔改变进入眼睛的光量，作用类似照相机的光圈。
瞳孔后方的晶状体 $6$ 是透明、具有透镜作用的结构，不是简单的一层薄膜。
原书标为肌肉 $7$ 的结构参与改变晶状体的曲率，看近物时晶状体可以变得更凸。
晶状体后方、直到眼球后壁的空间主要由透明的胶状玻璃体 $8$ 占据，原书的“半液体状”是粗略描述。
眼球后部内侧有视网膜 $9$，原书也称它为网状膜。
视神经 $10$ 把来自视网膜、经过处理的信号传向脑。
需要澄清：视网膜是含有感光细胞和其他神经细胞的组织，杆状细胞和锥状细胞是其中的感光细胞，不是视神经的杆状或锥状分支。
这些编号保留原书的部位对应，不能把旧示意图当作完整的现代解剖图。
en: The eyeball is roughly spherical (Figure 184), with a diameter of about $2.5$ cm.
Its white protective outer tissue is the sclera $1$, while the transparent tissue at the front is the cornea $2$.
The source describes the cornea as the transparent front part of the sclera, but a clarification is needed: the cornea joins the sclera and is not simply sclera that has become transparent.
Behind the cornea lies the iris $3$, whose color comes from pigment in its tissue rather than from being dyed.
The anterior chamber between the cornea and iris contains aqueous humor $4$, and the opening in the iris is the pupil $5$.
The pupil changes size reflexively as the incoming light changes, but the source's diameter range of about $2$ to $8$ mm is only approximate and varies with conditions and between people.
By changing the amount of light entering the eye, the pupil acts somewhat like a camera aperture.
Behind it is the crystalline lens $6$, a transparent structure that acts as a lens rather than a simple thin membrane.
The structure identified as muscle $7$ in the source participates in changing the lens curvature, allowing the lens to become more convex for near viewing.
The space behind the lens toward the back of the eye is mainly occupied by the transparent, gel-like vitreous $8$, for which the source's description as semi-liquid is approximate.
The retina $9$ lines the inner back of the eye and is also called the net-like membrane in the source.
The optic nerve $10$ carries processed signals from the retina toward the brain.
A clarification is important: the retina contains photoreceptors and other nerve cells, and rods and cones are its photoreceptor cells, not rod-shaped or cone-shaped branches of the optic nerve.
These numbers retain the source's anatomical correspondences without treating its historical diagram as a complete modern anatomical drawing.
concepts: Approximate spherical eye and source diameter
Sclera and cornea correspondences, with tissue distinction
Pigmented iris rather than artificial dye
Anterior-chamber aqueous humor and pupil
Approximate reflex pupil range and camera aperture analogy
Crystalline lens and muscle-mediated curvature change
Vitreous, retina, rods, cones and optic nerve with explicit anatomical clarification

zh: 入眼的光在角膜表面发生主要的折射，晶状体还提供补充折射，并参与调焦。
在靠近光轴的近轴近似中，可以把角膜、晶状体及其他介质合在一起，用一枚焦距可变的等效会聚薄透镜表示眼睛的光学系统。
这个模型把视网膜的位置看作固定，因而把透镜到成像处的像距看作近似不变。
这只是帮助分析成像的简化，真实眼睛具有多个折射界面，并不是一枚薄透镜。
视网膜在这个比喻中相当于屏幕，所看物体在它上面形成倒立的实像。
但活的视网膜不是平面屏幕，光作用于杆状细胞和锥状细胞后产生信号，再经神经处理传向脑，形成视觉。
en: Most of the refraction of light entering the eye occurs at the corneal surface, while the crystalline lens adds refraction and contributes to focusing.
For rays close to the optical axis, a paraxial approximation can represent the cornea, lens and other media together as an equivalent converging thin lens with a variable focal length.
This model treats the retina's position as fixed, so the image distance from the equivalent lens to the image is approximately constant.
It is a simplification for studying image formation, not a claim that the real eye, with its several refracting surfaces, is a single thin lens.
The retina acts as the screen in this analogy, receiving an inverted real image of the object.
A living retina is not a flat screen, however, and light acting on rods and cones produces signals that undergo neural processing and travel toward the brain to support vision.
concepts: Major corneal refraction and supplementary lens refraction
Variable focal length with approximately fixed image distance
Explicit paraxial equivalent-thin-lens limitation
Inverted real retinal image and screen analogy
Photoreception and neural processing

zh: 对于没有屈光不正的理想眼睛，看远物时调节可以处于放松状态，物体的像仍落在视网膜上。
物体移近时，睫状肌的活动通过悬韧带改变对晶状体的牵拉，使晶状体更凸、眼睛的等效焦距减小，从而使成像位置重新落在视网膜上。
原书用“晶状体的压缩”描述这一变化，这里指肌肉活动造成的曲率变化，不是把晶状体整个挤压压缩。
眼睛为适应所看物体的距离而改变聚焦能力的过程，叫作眼的调节。
对同样间隔的两个物点，把物体移近会增大它们在眼前张开的角度，也就是视角 $\varphi$（图 185）。
较大的视角有助于分开细节，原书用大于 $1$ 角分作为分辨两个点的粗略参考。
实际分辨能力还取决于光照、对比度以及视网膜和神经处理，不能只凭两个像落在不同感光细胞上就保证看见两个分开的点。
不过，移得越近并不总能看得越清楚，因为眼的调节能力有一个限度。
在给定条件下还能调节看清的最近物点叫作调节近点，物体比它更近时，即使视角增大，也不能靠继续调节使像清晰。
en: For an ideal eye without refractive error, accommodation can be relaxed when viewing a distant object while its image still falls on the retina.

As the object moves closer, ciliary muscle activity changes the pull on the lens through the suspensory fibers, allowing greater lens curvature and a shorter equivalent focal length so that the image again falls on the retina.
The source calls this lens compression, but the intended focusing change should be understood as a muscle-mediated change in curvature, not compression of the lens as a whole body.
This adjustment of focusing ability to the distance of the object is called accommodation.
For two object points with a fixed separation, moving the object closer increases the angle they subtend at the eye, the visual angle $\varphi$ (Figure 185).
A larger visual angle helps separate detail, and the source uses an angle greater than $1$ arcminute as a rough reference for distinguishing two points.

Actual resolution also depends on illumination, contrast, and retinal and neural processing, so images falling on different photoreceptors alone do not guarantee that two separate points will be seen.
Moving the object ever closer therefore does not always make it clearer, because accommodation has a limit.

The nearest object point that can still be brought into clear focus under given conditions is the near point of accommodation, and a closer object cannot be made clear simply by accommodating further, even though its visual angle is larger.
concepts: Relaxed distant viewing in the ideal emmetropic model
Near-object focusing, increased curvature and shorter equivalent focal length
Explicit non-compression interpretation of historical muscle description
Accommodation definition
Visual angle of separated points and increase on approach
Source angular-resolution reference qualified rather than deleted
Finite accommodation and near point

zh: 原书把既便于观察细节、又不需过度调节的距离叫作最佳视觉距离，也叫明视距离。
初等光学常取 $25$ 厘米作为明视距离的约定参考，并不表示每个人的调节近点或最舒适距离都等于这个值。
即使没有屈光不正，观察很近的物体也可能需要较强的调节。
因此应区分约定的明视距离、个人能看清的最近距离和当时的舒适程度。
en: The source calls a distance suitable for seeing detail without excessive accommodation the best viewing distance, or the distance of distinct vision.
Elementary optics commonly takes $25$ cm as a conventional reference for distinct vision, not as everyone's near point or most comfortable viewing distance.
Even an eye without refractive error may need stronger accommodation to view a very close object.
The conventional reference, an individual's nearest clear viewing distance, and comfort under current conditions must therefore be distinguished.
concepts: Best viewing distance and distance of distinct vision
Source comfortable-distance convention retained
Convention is neither universal near point nor universal comfort rule
Greater accommodation for very near viewing

zh: 在没有屈光不正的理想模型中，眼睛放松调节时能看清的最远物点叫作调节远点。
这样的眼睛把远点视为无限远，表示来自远物的近似平行光可在放松调节时聚焦到视网膜上。
en: In the ideal model without refractive error, the most distant object point seen clearly with accommodation relaxed is the far point.
The far point is taken to be at infinity, meaning that approximately parallel rays from a distant object can focus on the retina without accommodation.
concepts: Far-point definition bound to relaxed accommodation
Infinity for the ideal eye without refractive error

zh: 转动眼球的肌肉能使两眼的轴转向所看的物体。
物体移近时，两眼通常更向内转，转眼肌的活动也随之改变。
原书用左右眼“紧张程度差别”描述这种距离线索，但不能理解为无论物体位于哪个方向，两眼的肌肉差别都必定随物体移近而增大。
由于两眼的观察位置不同，同一近物在两眼视网膜上形成的像也有细微差别。
脑利用这种双眼图像差异，并结合眼睛协调转动等线索，帮助判断物体及其不同部分的距离。
这些线索支持立体视觉，不是把肌肉的紧张程度直接当作测距尺。
en: Muscles that rotate the eyeballs turn their axes toward the object being viewed.
For a nearer object, the eyes generally turn farther inward, with corresponding changes in the activity of these muscles.

The source describes a difference in muscular tension between the eyes as a distance cue, but this should not be read as a universal increase in left-right muscle differences for every direction of viewing.
Because the eyes view from different positions, a nearby object also produces slightly different retinal images in the two eyes.
The brain uses these binocular image differences, together with cues from coordinated eye movements, to help judge distances to the object and its parts.
These cues support three-dimensional perception rather than making muscle tension a direct distance ruler.
concepts: Eye-axis orientation by extraocular muscles
Near-viewing convergence and qualified muscular distance cue
Different left and right retinal images
Distance estimates for object parts and stereoscopic impression

zh: 在近视的光学模型中，眼睛放松调节时，远物的光会在视网膜前会聚（图 186(a)），所以远物不能在视网膜上形成清晰的像。
这种屈光状态叫作近视。
未矫正近视眼的远点在有限距离，而不是无限远，较近的物体能否看清还要看它是否处于可调节的范围内。
原书说近视眼的明视距离相应较小，是描述较近的观察范围，不是给所有近视眼规定同一个舒适距离。
在这个模型中，发散透镜可以改变入眼光线的方向，说明近视眼镜的矫正原理。
来自远物的近似平行光通过透镜后向外发散，反向延长看起来来自眼睛的远点，也就是图 186(b) 中的 $A$ 点。
透镜若使这些光线与眼睛放松调节时的聚焦能力相配合，眼睛就能把远物的像聚焦到视网膜上。
这样解释了眼镜如何使远物清晰而不额外要求调节，并不保证任何镜片都能使所有近视眼达到相同的视觉状态。
en: In the optical model of myopia, light from a distant object converges in front of the retina when accommodation is relaxed (Figure 186(a)), so the retinal image of the distant object is blurred.
This refractive state is called myopia, or nearsightedness.
An uncorrected myopic eye has a far point at a finite distance rather than at infinity, and whether a nearer object is clear also depends on its being within the available accommodation range.
The source's statement that the distance of distinct vision is smaller describes nearer viewing, not a single comfortable distance shared by all myopic eyes.
A diverging lens changes the directions of incoming rays in this model and explains the optical principle of myopia-correcting spectacles.
Approximately parallel rays from a distant object diverge after the lens, and their backward extensions appear to originate at the eye's far point, shown in Figure 186(b) as point $A$.
If the lens makes these rays match the eye's focusing ability with accommodation relaxed, the distant image can focus on the retina.
This explains clear distant viewing without an additional demand for accommodation, not a guarantee that any lens gives every myopic eye the same visual state.
concepts: Relaxed myopic distant focus in front of the retina
Distance blur and finite uncorrected far point
Nearer viewing and cautious comfortable-distance interpretation
Diverging spectacle lens
Backward ray extensions through the source far-point label
Matched-lens relaxed distant viewing rather than universal clinical promise

zh: 在远视的光学模型中，放松调节时，远物的光若继续传播，会在视网膜后会聚（图 187(a)）。
这时实际到达视网膜的光尚未正确聚焦，这种屈光状态叫作远视。
有些远视眼能用调节补偿远距离成像，能否补偿以及需要多少调节，取决于其屈光状态和调节能力。
看近物还会增加调节需求，原书用明视距离大于 $25$ 厘米说明近看可能更困难，并不是每个远视眼都必定具有这样的固定距离。
en: In the optical model of hyperopia, with accommodation relaxed, light from a distant object would converge behind the retina if it continued onward (Figure 187(a)).
The light actually reaching the retina is then not properly focused, and this refractive state is called hyperopia, or farsightedness.
Some hyperopic eyes can use accommodation to compensate during distant viewing, but whether compensation is possible and how much is needed depend on the refractive state and available accommodation.

Near viewing adds a further accommodation demand, and the source uses a distance of distinct vision greater than $25$ cm to illustrate possible difficulty with close viewing, not a fixed distance that every hyperopic eye must have.
concepts: Hyperopic distant focus behind the retina in the relaxed model
Actual retinal interception versus hypothetical onward convergence
Possible distant accommodation with conditional capacity
Additional near demand and qualified source distance comparison

zh: 会聚透镜改变入眼光线的方向，可以用来说明远视眼镜的矫正原理。
在远物成像的模型中，透镜的光焦度需与眼睛的屈光状态和所取的调节状态相配合，使近似平行的入射光经眼睛后聚焦在视网膜上（图 187(b)）。
在原书的近物构图中，距离眼睛 $25$ 厘米的物体发出的光（图 187(c)），经过会聚透镜后发散程度减小。
进入眼睛的光反向延长，看起来来自距离为 $d>25$ 厘米的虚像，眼睛因而把它当作较远的物体来调焦。
在这一构图的条件下，适当的会聚透镜可减少近看所需的调节，让约定明视距离处的物体也能看清，而不需原来那样大的调节需求。
原书所谓明视距离与正常眼睛一样，应理解为这个简化例子的成像结果，不是所有人的舒适距离都会相同，也不是选择镜片的建议。
en: A converging lens changes incoming ray directions and explains the optical principle of hyperopia-correcting spectacles.

In the distant-viewing model, its optical power must match the eye's refractive state and the assumed accommodation state so that approximately parallel incident rays focus on the retina after passing through the eye (Figure 187(b)).
In the source's near-viewing construction, light from an object $25$ cm from the eye (Figure 187(c)) becomes less divergent after passing through the converging lens.
Backward extensions of the rays reaching the eye appear to come from a virtual image at a distance $d>25$ cm, which the eye treats as a more distant object when focusing.

Under the conditions of this construction, a suitable converging lens can reduce the accommodation demand for near viewing and allow clear viewing at the conventional distance of distinct vision without the original greater demand.
The source's conclusion that this distance becomes the same as for a normal eye describes that simplified example, not identical comfort for everyone or advice for choosing spectacle lenses.
concepts: Converging spectacle lens and matched optical power
Distant parallel-ray retinal focus
Near-object source distance and reduced divergence
Apparent farther virtual-image distance with unchanged inequality
Reduced accommodation demand and conventional-distance outcome
Explicit rejection of universal comfort or lens-selection recommendation

scientificLimitations.historicalClaim: Transparent anterior sclera, dyed iris, a lens-like layer, semi-liquid vitreous, and retina described as optic-nerve branches ending in rods and cones.
scientificLimitations.clarification: Keep the original numbered correspondences while distinguishing cornea from sclera, tissue pigmentation, crystalline lens, gel-like vitreous, retinal photoreceptors and other cells, and outgoing optic-nerve signaling.
scientificLimitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess anatomical accuracy and age-appropriate wording; FIG must independently assess the future modern anatomical drawing without relying on this author as visual evidence.

scientificLimitations.historicalClaim: Reflex pupil diameter range and camera aperture analogy.
scientificLimitations.clarification: Preserve both original endpoints and the light-control analogy, while explicitly calling the range approximate and condition- and person-dependent.
scientificLimitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess the qualification; no pupil measurement, medical threshold or new numerical recommendation is supplied.

scientificLimitations.historicalClaim: Whole-eye converging lens with variable focal length, fixed image distance and retinal screen.
scientificLimitations.clarification: Scope the equivalent thin lens to near-axis/paraxial analysis, approximate the fixed image distance, retain the inverted real image, and distinguish the multisurface living eye and retina from lens and flat-screen objects.
scientificLimitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess model boundaries; no new lens equation or quantitative model is introduced.

scientificLimitations.historicalClaim: Muscle tension compresses the lens, reduces focal length, and defines near and far limits.
scientificLimitations.clarification: Explicitly replace literal body compression with ciliary-muscle/suspensory-fiber-mediated curvature change, retain refocusing and finite near point, and bind the ideal infinite far point to relaxed accommodation without refractive error.
scientificLimitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess mechanism and relaxed-state assumptions; no measured near point is inferred.

scientificLimitations.historicalClaim: Larger visual angle separates point images and the source angular threshold maps them to different nerve endings.
scientificLimitations.clarification: Retain visual angle, approaching-object reasoning and the original angular reference, but identify it as approximate and include contrast, illumination and retinal/neural processing rather than a guaranteed one-cell rule.
scientificLimitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess resolution wording; this is not a vision-test threshold or diagnostic instruction.

scientificLimitations.historicalClaim: A fixed comfortable distance for normal eyes, shorter for myopia, longer for hyperopia, and restored by spectacles.
scientificLimitations.clarification: Retain the original comfortable-reference value and near-viewing inequality, but separate the elementary-optics convention, actual near point, available accommodation and individual comfort.
scientificLimitations.pendingReview: SCI must check that source conclusions remain conditional and ZHEN must check equal strength of qualification; no universal comfortable distance is asserted.

scientificLimitations.historicalClaim: Differences in muscular tension and left/right retinal images provide distance and stereoscopic impressions.
scientificLimitations.clarification: Preserve both muscle-related and binocular-image cues while using coordinated convergence and disparity rather than a universal left-right tension difference or direct muscle-tension ruler.
scientificLimitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess binocular cue wording; original difficult material is retained, not omitted.

scientificLimitations.historicalClaim: Relaxed myopic focus lies before the retina; diverging spectacles make parallel rays appear to originate at the finite far point.
scientificLimitations.clarification: Retain focus position, finite far point, lens type and labeled ray construction, but make relaxed distant viewing depend on an optically matched lens and avoid universal normal-vision promises.
scientificLimitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess ray construction; FIG must review future panel labels and the far-point label independently.

scientificLimitations.historicalClaim: Behind-retina distant focus, accommodation at distance, harder near viewing, and converging-lens corrections.
scientificLimitations.clarification: Bind behind-retina convergence to the relaxed model, explain actual retinal interception, make compensation conditional on available accommodation, and preserve distant and near converging-lens constructions and reduced divergence.
scientificLimitations.pendingReview: SCI must assess accommodation-state and virtual-image-distance interpretation; FIG must independently review all future panels.

scientificLimitations.historicalClaim: Spectacle corrections restore relaxed or comfortable viewing.
scientificLimitations.clarification: Present only the source's qualitative optical constructions, with no diagnosis, prescription, medical recommendation, additional numerical value or new formula.
scientificLimitations.pendingReview: SCI and ZHEN must assess that neither language reads as a clinical recommendation.
